expect: 65.7% after 1000 cycles at 1C/2C (p2.L99-100); lithium 1.015 to 0.993 (p5.L66-67): 2.2% lower
question: What capacity did the 1.4 Ah pouch cell keep after its cycling and over how many cycles, and by what percentage did the lithium content of the NMC622 fall on delamination?
rendered:
According to the text, the 1.4 Ah pouch cell was charged/discharged at 1 C/2 C rates for 1000 cycles and the capacity degraded to 65.7% of its initial capacity. 

The lithium content of the NMC622 cathode materials before and after delamination was measured by using an inductively coupled plasma optical emission spectrometer (ICP-OES, Agilent Technologies 5110). The lithium content of the NMC622 cathode materials revealed by ICP-OES was reduced from 1.015 to 0.993 after delamination, most probably due to the lithium leaching in the delamination and washing steps.
